name: Our Toy Box
source:
Are you ready to forsake all you have and leave everything behind?
Play as a nameless protagonist and recover your memories in this short kinetic visual novel.

[From [url=https://elseth.itch.io/our-toy-box]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你准备好放弃你所拥有的一切并抛下一切了吗？
在这部简短的动态视觉小说中扮演无名主角并恢复你的记忆。

[来自[url=https://elseth.itch.io/our-toy-box]itch.io[/url]]
